Name: Cozy Tent Kit
Author: CactusCouch
Description:
[b]Give your adventures a cozier touch![/b] ⛺
[heading]🌿 About This Mod[/heading]
Cozy Tent Kit brings a little extra charm to your Stardew Valley adventures with a custom tent design. Whether you're setting up camp on a quiet evening, decorating your favorite outdoor space, or adding a little personality to your farm, Cozy Tent Kit offers a simple visual refresh for players who love making their Stardew Valley world feel like home. [u][i]This mod does not make the tent a permanent fixture; it is still a single-use item.[/i][/u]
[heading]✨ Features[/heading]
[list]
[*][b]Custom Tent Design[/b] — A unique retexture for the vanilla tent sprite.[/*]
[*][b]Stardew Valley Style[/b] — Pixel art designed to complement the game's original aesthetic.[/*]
[*][b]Lightweight & Simple[/b] — A straightforward visual mod focused on customization.[/*]
[*][b]Easy Installation[/b] — Uses SMAPI and Content Patcher for convenient installation.[/*]
[*][b]Compatible with Existing Saves[/b] — No new save file required.[/*]
[/list][heading]📦 Requirements[/heading]
[list]
[*][url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url][/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url][/*]
[/list][heading]🛠️ Installation[/heading]
[list=1]
[*]Install SMAPI if you haven't already.[/*]
[*]Install Content Patcher.[/*]
[*]Download Cozy Tent Kit.[/*]
[*]Extract the downloaded folder into your Stardew Valley
[code]Mods[/code]folder.[/*]
[*]Launch the game through SMAPI and enjoy your new tent![/*]
[/list][heading]💖 Support & Feedback[/heading]
Thank you for checking out Cozy Tent Kit! [u][i]This is my second mod ever made so if you enjoy the mod, endorsements, feedback, and screenshots are always appreciated.[/i][/u] If you encounter any issues, please include your SMAPI log when reporting a bug so I can investigate.
Happy farming, and happy camping! 🌙
